project.title: Integrated Service Lane for Vehicle Sales and Workshop
project.objective: Design and pilot an integrated intake process that connects vehicle sales, service booking, and workshop diagnosis to improve customer throughput and satisfaction.
deliverables: Standardised integrated intake workflow for sales and service customers
Service lane checklist and diagnostic triage guide for technicians
Sales-to-workshop handover script and documentation template
Staff rota and lane capacity plan for peak and off-peak hours
Pilot performance report with KPIs and improvement actions
constraints: Pilot must run within existing showroom and workshop layout
No additional full-time headcount; use current staff and shifts
Process must comply with safety and warranty requirements
Customer waiting time target under 20 minutes for intake
All documentation must be usable on existing systems or paper forms

risks.risk: Technicians resist new intake and triage steps, slowing down work.
risks.mitigation: Involve technicians in designing the checklist and run a short training with feedback loop.

risks.risk: Sales staff do not consistently capture technical details needed by workshop.
risks.mitigation: Provide a simple handover form and quick coaching; monitor random samples in first two weeks.

risks.risk: Peak-time congestion in the service lane leads to customer complaints.
risks.mitigation: Create a capacity plan, introduce time-slot booking, and define overflow rules to standard bays.

risks.risk: New process documentation is not kept up to date after pilot.
risks.mitigation: Assign a process owner and schedule monthly reviews to update checklists and scripts.

themes.why_relevant: Poor handovers cause rework and delays; clear scripts and forms reduce confusion.

themes.theme: Workshop triage and diagnostics at intake
themes.why_relevant: Early triage by technicians improves bay allocation and parts readiness.
Setting clear timelines and costs at intake reduces complaints and follow-up calls.

themes.theme: Safety and compliance in the service lane
themes.why_relevant: New lane flow must respect safety rules and warranty procedures.
Integrated lane changes who does what when; shifts must be adjusted without extra headcount.

backlog.task: Map current customer journey from sales floor or phone call to workshop handover
definition_of_done: End-to-end process map created for sales and service entry points
Pain points and delays identified and documented
Map reviewed with one seller, one technician, and one supervisor

backlog.task: Design standard sales-to-workshop handover form and script
definition_of_done: Handover form drafted with required technical and customer data
Short verbal script written for in-person and phone customers
Form and script validated by a vehicle technician and assembly supervisor

backlog.task: Create service lane intake and triage checklist for technicians
definition_of_done: Checklist covers safety, basic diagnostics, and documentation steps
Checklist tested on at least 5 recent service cases
Feedback from technicians collected and final version agreed

backlog.task: Define new lane workflow and bay allocation rules
definition_of_done: Lane workflow diagram created from arrival to bay assignment
Rules for urgent, warranty, and routine jobs documented
Workflow approved by garage manager and shared with team

backlog.task: Plan staff rota and role assignments for integrated lane pilot
definition_of_done: Rota for sellers, technicians, and supervisors created for pilot period
Peak and off-peak coverage checked against forecasted volume
Rota communicated to all affected staff at least 3 days before pilot

backlog.task: Train sales staff on new intake script and handover form
definition_of_done: Training session agenda prepared and delivered
All active sellers attend or receive catch-up briefing
At least 3 role-play scenarios completed and feedback captured

backlog.task: Train technicians on service lane checklist and triage expectations
definition_of_done: Briefing session held with all lane technicians
Example cases used to walk through checklist
Technicians confirm understanding of documentation requirements

backlog.task: Set up simple tracking sheet for lane KPIs during pilot
definition_of_done: KPIs defined (e.g. intake time, rework cases, customer callbacks)
Tracking sheet created and accessible to supervisors
Data entry responsibilities assigned and documented

backlog.task: Run integrated lane pilot and capture daily issues
definition_of_done: Pilot runs for agreed period with new workflow in place
Daily log of issues and deviations maintained
Weekly summary shared with sellers and technicians

backlog.task: Collect customer feedback on new intake experience
definition_of_done: Short feedback script or form created for pilot customers
Feedback collected from at least 20 customers
Key themes summarised and shared with project stakeholders

backlog.task: Review safety and compliance aspects of new lane process
definition_of_done: Checklist reviewed against safety and warranty requirements
Any non-compliant steps identified and corrected
Supervisor signs off on safety compliance for pilot

backlog.task: Produce final pilot report and improvement plan
definition_of_done: Pilot data and feedback analysed and summarised
Key successes, issues, and root causes documented
Action plan with owners and dates agreed with supervisors and sellers

artifacts.title: Safety and Compliance Review List for Lane Operations
artifacts.used_for: Ensures the new lane process respects safety and warranty requirements.

artifacts.title: Customer Feedback Summary for Pilot
artifacts.used_for: Aggregated view of customer comments on the new intake experience.

artifacts.title: Staff Rota and Role Assignment for Integrated Lane
artifacts.used_for: Shows who is assigned to the lane and when during the pilot period.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current-state process map and main pain points.
threads_plan.trigger: Garage manager shares first draft of the end-to-end process map.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final version of the current-state process map for intake and handover.
Prioritise top three pain points to address in the pilot design.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define the new intake workflow, handover form, and triage checklist.
threads_plan.trigger: Seller posts draft handover script and technician posts draft triage checklist.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the structure and mandatory fields of the handover form.
Approve the steps and timing of the service lane triage checklist.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in lane capacity rules, staff rota, and pilot schedule.
threads_plan.trigger: Garage manager shares draft rota and capacity rules for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot start date and duration for the integrated lane.
Agree on final staff rota and bay allocation rules for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Monitor pilot progress, surface issues, and adjust quickly.
threads_plan.trigger: First day of pilot operations with initial KPI data and incident notes.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide on any immediate process tweaks needed after first pilot week.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results, customer feedback, and next steps.
threads_plan.trigger: Garage manager posts draft pilot report and customer feedback summary.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide whether to roll out the integrated lane process permanently and what improvements to implement.

channel_rituals: Daily short async check-in during pilot with yesterday's lane stats and today's risks.
Weekly review thread to discuss issues log, safety observations, and quick wins.
Pre-pilot readiness checklist review one day before go-live.
Post-pilot retrospective to capture lessons learned and update process documents.
